pageCache.pageTitle: Holy Trinity Church of England Primary School, Lower Beeding
pageCache.text:
Starting School in September 2027?
Come and discover all that HTLB has to offer! Join us for one of our friendly Open Morning sessions,
held evey Friday from 9.30am to 10.30am between 18th September and 23rd October.
Meet our team, see our wonderful school in action, and find out why HTLB is such a special place to learn
To book your place, please contact the school office on 01403 891263 or office@htlb.school.
Can't make these dates? Please get in touch and we'll be happy to arrange an alternative visit.
We look forward to meeting you!
